summary: Nexera Technologies Ltd (formerly Jeffs' Brands Ltd), a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K covering its semi-annual report for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing discloses routine operational and financial updates, including subsequent events such as convertible debt and warrant matters and an equity interest in Fort Technology Inc. No special-situation transaction—acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review—is announced. The report appears to be a standard periodic disclosure of financial results and related-party transactions, with no board recommendation, deal terms, or extraordinary corporate action triggering classification.
